text:
Leah: Async CS standup for Catalyst Health — renewal in 12 days. Short summary: they reported a chat quality regression after we rolled `redwood-chat-3.1` on Fri 2026-02-27 09:12 UTC. They're calling this a renewal risk :warning: and want a corrective plan.

Leah: What I did: filed ticket CH-4821, collected 6 failing convo examples, took customer call to capture their SLA concerns. Added eval set to the ticket and flagged for urgent.

Leah: Blockers: need eng triage to decide rollback vs prompt-fix. Legal asked for exported logs for RCA (I have approval). Customer wants an ETA on fix.

Sam: I can take the triage. Can you paste the minimized failing convo + model/rollout meta? Also confirm whether this is hosted or Dedicated for them. If Dedicated we can snapshot and rollback quicker.

Leah: Hosted (customer on Redwood Hosted with enterprise SLA). Minimized convo + notes attached in CH-4821: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CH-4821

Leah: Example snippet:```
User: "Summarize my benefits in plain language"
Model (expected): "Your plan covers X, Y, Z. Here's what that means in everyday terms..."
Model (observed): "Error: could not retrieve policy data"
```

Noah: I'll run the eval harness on the 6-example set now (local quantized replica). If it's a logits/temperature drift from the new weights, we should see it in batch eval within ~25-40m.

Sam: Noted. From quick checks latency looks same, token mix is similar. My hypothesis is a subtle change to system prompts or safety filter thresholds during the rollout. If it's safety-filter related we might be able to hotfix without rollback.

Jess: I'll draft a customer-facing acknowledgement and an ops bulletin for Dedicated customers in case we need a broader rollback notice. Leah — give me the two-sentence summary I can send by EOD.

Leah: Two-sentence ack for customers: "Thanks for flagging this. We're investigating a quality regression tied to a recent model rollout and will update with a remediation plan within 4 hours." Feel free to shorten.

Sam: Quick ask for eng: can infra/rollout team hold further rollouts to `redwood-chat-*` for 24h? @deploy-bot can we pause the next scheduled canary?

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline for `redwood-chat` paused by request from @Sam at 2026-02-27T10:02:13Z :white_check_mark:

Noah: Eval results incoming — preliminary: 4/6 examples show semantic drop (token probability mass shifted). Sending detailed diffs to CH-4821 shortly.

Sam: Thanks. If diffs confirm weight-induced change, plan A = rollback to `redwood-chat-3.0` (ops runbook ready), plan B = prompt shim + filter tunings if we can patch quickly. Which does CS prefer?

Leah: Customer prefers the fastest path that restores behavior; they accept a short rollback if that's quickest. They also want an exec note explaining root cause and safeguards.

Jess: I'll own the customer note and the renewal-facing summary. Leah — looping you for approvals before send.

Sam: I'll coordinate rollback playbook and post the ETA here once Noah posts diffs. If rollback needed, schedule target within next 2 hours.

Leah: Blocker for me: need eng confirmation on rollback window + short Govt-approved wording for the exec note. Also please tag me on any customer-facing drafts.

Noah: Diff dump uploaded to CH-4821. TL;DR: logits shift in three intent-handling tokens; looks model-weight related.

Sam: Ack. I'm starting rollback prep now. If anyone sees further customer messages, forward to me and Leah.

Leah: Thanks team. I'll keep the customer in the loop and escalate internally if we miss the 4-hour remediation target. :eyes:

Jess: I'll post the draft note in CH-4821 for review in 15m.

Leah: Final — followups: Sam (eng) will confirm rollback ETA, Noah will validate diffs, Jess will prepare customer & renewal comms, Leah will coordinate exec summary + approval.

Leah: tagging participants for visibility: @Sam @Noah @Jess.
